title: Ask for a change
summary: GraphQL: Ask for a change. Set the value to 6.
introduction: A mutation names a write action. This local example changes one in-memory score.
learningObjectives: Ask for a change with GraphQL

blocks.text: In a practice folder run npm init -y and npm install graphql@16. Save one example as lesson.mjs and run node lesson.mjs. These examples execute queries locally and do not need an HTTP server.

blocks.title: Ask for a change

blocks.text: The mutation resolver receives 8, stores it in the local score and returns the new value.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: The resolver must implement the change; declaring a mutation alone does not save data.
